glb_checks.limitation: Structural checks do not prove renderer or arbitrary shader equivalence.

render.visualReview: Reviewed at 1920×1080: complete lab visible, readable signage, preserved equipment/materials; renderer differences remain.

triangleDifferences.note: Native FBX import uses default degenerate removal. Counts differ on two source meshes; this report preserves both source and measured native triangle counts, and does not claim byte-identical geometry.

limitations: PBR values and image textures are transferred; arbitrary Blender procedural shader graphs are not equivalent.
Normal texture strength scales tangent X/Y before normalization. Source parent hierarchy is flattened to world transforms and category folders.
Normal textures assume Blender tangent-space OpenGL; Unreal texture green channel is flipped for DirectX. Tangent-space pixel parity is not measured.
Local light watts transfer at 100 lm/W and sun energy at 1000 lux/unit as an explicit artistic approximation.
Box collision is a simple proxy, not an exact collision mesh or a navigation bake.
GPU batching, gameplay, runtime performance and photometric parity require separate validation.

verification.coordinatePolicy: Blender RH meters Z-up → Unreal LH centimeters Z-up: reflect Y; cameras/lights rotate local -Z/+Y to +X/+Z.

navigation.reason: Simple collision is verified independently; a navigation bake and path query are not implied.

verification.instancingRepresentation: Individually editable StaticMeshActors reference shared StaticMesh assets; GPU instancing performance is not measured.

render.visualReview: Reviewed at 1920×1080: complete lab visible, readable signage, preserved equipment/materials; renderer differences remain.

public_packaging: PNG text metadata removed without pixel changes. Native blend files are portable, packed-texture work copies reopened before packaging. Logs and absolute local paths are omitted.
